structured_output.title: New default CertificateRequest revisionHistoryLimit may affect Certificates here
structured_output.content: The v1.18.0 release notes say the default `revisionHistoryLimit` for CertificateRequest revisions is now 1. This environment uses this resource family: its manifests include `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate`, and the CRD `certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]` is installed. Check whether your Certificate manifests set `revisionHistoryLimit` themselves. Any that don't would pick up the new default, so also check whether anything you run (audits, debugging, tooling) depends on older CertificateRequest revisions being kept.
